decisions.reason: Distant from core and no demonstrated traction after two years makes its option value unlikely to be realized.
Adjacent to core crew services, its option can be kept at low cost while superyacht demand uncertainty remains.
Early partner network growth signals positive resolution of uncertainty and supports further commitment.
Strong compliance delivery result confirms its value and close fit with existing services.
Integrated digital tool faces regulatory demand uncertainty but entails low marginal cost to keep.
Similar integrated simulation tool is a low-cost option whose value may rise with FuelEU compliance needs.
